readme: Priority-ordered search queries the daily blog generator writes against (node tools/generate-blog-post.mjs --next). A topic is consumed once website/src/content/blog/<slug>.md exists; nothing here changes when a post ships. Every demo, doc and api reference is validated by tools/seo-guardrails.test.ts. Sources: gsc = Search Console query with impressions and no page, p2 = marketing/seo-content-plan.md money term, ai-prompts = a question from website/src/lib/ai-prompts.ts, api = an SvGridApi identifier people search for, component = a UI component x task query.

topics.workingTitle: A Svelte Kanban board with drag-and-drop lanes, from the rows you already have
topics.brief: Same rows and columns as the table, one board prop. Cover lane bucketing by a status field, onCardMove updating your own data, WIP limits and a rich card snippet. Do not explain what Kanban is; the reader has one to build.

topics.workingTitle: Choosing a Svelte data grid: the questions that actually decide it
topics.brief: Decision content, not a sales page. Lead with the four questions that decide it: row count, editing, whether you own the markup, and licence. You MUST weigh the real options by name and say where each wins: TanStack Table (headless, you write every row of markup, first-party Svelte 5 adapter since v9), svelte-headless-table (the Svelte 4 incumbent, stalled on Svelte 5), SVAR wx-svelte-grid (MIT and genuinely free, multi-framework, Webix pedigree), AG Grid (the feature ceiling, React-first, heavy), and @vincjo/datatables (small and sharp for simple tables). Concede plainly where SvGrid loses: SVAR is free where our export is paid, AG Grid has more enterprise surface, TanStack has far more users. A reader who catches you shading it stops trusting the page, and so does a model quoting it.

topics.workingTitle: A Svelte datagrid in five minutes: install, columns, sorting, filtering
topics.brief: The shortest honest path from npm install to a sortable, filterable, paginated grid. Show the data + columns shape first, then the features array. Mention SvelteKit works out of the box. End with what to read next.

topics.workingTitle: What to look for in a Svelte 5 UI component library
topics.brief: The umbrella query, and nothing currently answers it. Criteria: Svelte 5 runes support, whether you can reach a headless core, accessibility depth, theming via tokens, and install model (dependency versus copy-in). You MUST name the real options and where each is stronger: shadcn-svelte (copy-in, you own the code, best-in-class taste), Skeleton (Tailwind-native, strong design system), Flowbite-Svelte (widest component count), and Bits UI or Melt UI (headless primitives when you own the markup). Be honest that SvGrid UI is grid-adjacent: it is the strongest choice when a data grid is the centre of the app, and a harder sell when it is not.

topics.workingTitle: A Svelte modal that traps focus, restores it, and closes the way users expect
topics.brief: Focus trap, restore-on-close, Esc and backdrop dismissal, and scroll lock. Show the nesting case (a confirm on top of a form) since that is where hand-rolled modals break. Do not sell the grid; the reader wants a dialog.

topics.workingTitle: Picking a Svelte scheduler: resources, recurrence and the things that bite later
topics.brief: Frame the decision: day/week/month versus resource timeline, recurrence with exceptions, drag to reschedule, time zones, and business-hour rules. Recurrence and time zones are what turn a weekend build into a quarter, so spend the words there. You MUST name what people actually reach for and be fair about it: a plain calendar library plus your own event layer, SVAR Gantt for dependency-driven planning rather than booking, and building on top of a headless table like TanStack Table. Say plainly that SvGrid renders the scheduler through the paid tier and that this is a real cost against the free options.

topics.workingTitle: Svelte grid table: sorting, filtering and pagination without writing the plumbing
topics.brief: Walk through the three features people wire by hand in a plain HTML table and show each one as a registered feature. Include the Excel-style filter menu and multi-column sort.

topics.workingTitle: A Svelte select that behaves like a native one but looks like your design system
topics.brief: Typeahead, keyboard selection, grouped options, and the disabled/placeholder states people forget. Say plainly when a native <select> is still the right answer.

topics.workingTitle: A Svelte kanban board without a second data model
topics.brief: The angle is that a board is a view of rows you already have, not a separate library with its own store. Cover lane bucketing, WIP limits, drag between lanes, and the Board/Table toggle. You MUST name the alternatives and say where they win: svelte-dnd-action (the drag primitive most hand-rolled Svelte boards are built on, and the right answer when a board is all you need), and a headless table like TanStack Table with your own board renderer. Concede that if you never need a table view, a dedicated board library is less machinery than a grid.

topics.workingTitle: Toast notifications in Svelte 5, including the ones you fire from outside a component
topics.brief: The store-driven API, variants, duration and dismissal, and stacking. Cover firing a toast from a plain .ts module (a fetch wrapper, an error boundary) because that is the part people get stuck on.

topics.workingTitle: Picking a Svelte grid component: headless core or drop-in render component
topics.brief: The decision most teams face once: own the markup with the headless engine, or take the render component and theme it. Give the tradeoffs with bundle numbers and a code sample of each, and say when each one is wrong.

topics.workingTitle: Svelte tabs with real keyboard support, and a headless core when you need your own markup
topics.brief: Arrow-key roving tabindex, aria-selected wiring, lazy panel content. Contrast the styled component with the headless core so a reader with a design system sees the escape hatch.

topics.workingTitle: Server-side data in a Svelte grid: fetching rows on demand
topics.brief: The request shape the grid sends (page, sort, filters), the response it expects, and a SvelteKit endpoint that answers it. Cover cursor and offset paging, and what happens on a slow network.

topics.workingTitle: Multi-select in Svelte 5: chips, select-all, and keeping the value shape sane
topics.brief: Chip rendering and removal, select-all semantics, max-selection limits, and what the bound value actually is. Cover using it as a grid cell editor once, briefly.

topics.workingTitle: SvForm: schema-driven forms in Svelte 5 with validation and layout in one object
topics.brief: A form defined as data: fields, types, validators, layout. Show a real signup or settings form, then the edit-form use inside a grid. Keep the schema visible in every code block.

topics.workingTitle: Svelte autocomplete with async suggestions, debouncing and out-of-order responses
topics.brief: Debounce, abort the in-flight request, and guard against a slow response overwriting a newer one. That race is the real content; the markup is easy.

topics.workingTitle: A SvelteKit data grid: load functions, SSR and the first paint
topics.brief: Where the data comes from in SvelteKit (load vs. client fetch), what renders on the server, and how to hydrate without a flash of empty grid. Include the starter template command.

topics.workingTitle: Drag-and-drop file upload in Svelte, with progress and the failure cases
topics.brief: Drag-over states, type and size validation, per-file progress, retry after a failed upload. Include the SvelteKit form-action side so it is end to end.

topics.workingTitle: A Svelte pivot table from flat rows: group, aggregate, pivot
topics.brief: Start from a flat sales dataset, show the pivot configuration (rows, columns, values), then the in-grid pivot mode toggle. Be clear that pivot ships in the enterprise package.

topics.workingTitle: Svelte tooltips that flip at the viewport edge and do not trap keyboard users
topics.brief: Collision-aware placement, hover intent delay, and touch/keyboard behaviour. Note when a tooltip should be a popover instead.

topics.workingTitle: Svelte Excel export: a real .xlsx from a data grid, styles and all
topics.brief: CSV is free in the core package; XLSX and PDF are enterprise. Show the export call, what carries over (formats, groups, pivots), and the import path back in.

topics.workingTitle: A Svelte drawer for edit panels: focus, scroll lock and unsaved-change guards
topics.brief: Side selection, sizing, focus handling, and warning before discarding edits. Use the record-edit panel as the running example.

topics.workingTitle: A SvelteKit CRUD app from a database schema, generated as code you own
topics.brief: From a Drizzle schema or sample rows to list, detail and edit screens. Emphasise that the output is plain SvelteKit source, not a runtime. Show the generated route file.

topics.workingTitle: A multi-step wizard in Svelte 5 with per-step validation you can actually gate on
topics.brief: Step state, gating Next on validity, going back without losing input, and a final review step. The gating is the hard part worth writing about.

topics.workingTitle: A Svelte admin dashboard: grid, stats and charts on one screen
topics.brief: The admin-dashboard starter template explained: layout, the grid as the centre, stat cards, a chart. Give the create command and what to change first.

topics.workingTitle: Right-click menus in Svelte, including nested items and keyboard access
topics.brief: Pointer positioning, submenu behaviour, and the Shift+F10 / Menu-key path most implementations skip.

topics.workingTitle: A Svelte virtual table: 100,000 rows with no pagination
topics.brief: Row and column virtualization explained with numbers: rows in the DOM, scroll frame time, memory. Fixed row height versus measured. When pagination is still the better answer.

topics.workingTitle: A Svelte tags input: paste a list, dedupe it, and validate as you go
topics.brief: Delimiter handling on paste, duplicate rejection, per-tag validation, and Backspace-to-remove. Small component, many edge cases.

topics.workingTitle: Svelte inline editing: typed cell editors, validation and dirty rows
topics.brief: Editor types per column, commit and cancel keys, validation messages, and tracking which rows changed before saving. Include a save-to-server example.

topics.workingTitle: An OTP input in Svelte that handles paste, autofill and backspace properly
topics.brief: Per-character boxes, distributing a pasted code, SMS autofill attributes, and backspace across boxes. Pair with the login block so it is a whole flow.

topics.workingTitle: A Svelte spreadsheet: cell ranges, copy-paste and a fill handle
topics.brief: Range selection, paste from Excel, the fill handle, and formulas. Show what the clipboard payload looks like and how pasted values are typed.

topics.workingTitle: Skeleton loaders in Svelte, and when a spinner is the better answer
topics.brief: Shape-matched placeholders, avoiding layout shift, and the honest guidance that under ~300ms you should show nothing at all.

topics.workingTitle: Group rows by a column in Svelte, with sums and averages per group
topics.brief: One-level and multi-level grouping, expand and collapse, aggregators per column, and a custom aggregator. Mention the drag-to-group panel briefly.

topics.workingTitle: A Svelte color input with a swatch, hex entry and preset palette
topics.brief: Native picker versus the popover, hex validation, and preset palettes. Mention the alpha question up front so nobody is surprised.

topics.workingTitle: An Excel-style filter menu for a Svelte table
topics.brief: The checkbox value list, search inside the menu, number and date operators, and applying filters programmatically. Contrast with a plain text filter row.

topics.workingTitle: Resizable split panes in Svelte, with sizes that survive a reload
topics.brief: Drag to resize, min/max constraints, nested splits, keyboard resizing, and persisting sizes. Point at the dock layout for the heavier case.

topics.workingTitle: A Svelte tree grid: hierarchical rows, expand and collapse, lazy children
topics.brief: Nested rows from a parent id, indentation, expand all, loading children on demand, and master/detail panels as the alternative. Show the data shape both ways.

topics.workingTitle: A Svelte slider with two handles, steps and marks that stays keyboard accessible
topics.brief: Single and range modes, step snapping, marks and labels, and the ARIA slider pattern. Show it filtering a numeric column once.

topics.workingTitle: An MCP server for a Svelte data grid: what Claude and Cursor actually get
topics.brief: Why an AI assistant writing grid code needs the real API and real demo sources, the install one-liner, and a before/after of generated code with and without the server.

topics.workingTitle: A Svelte number input that survives locales, precision and empty state
topics.brief: Min/max/step, thousands grouping, precision, prefix and suffix, and the difference between empty and zero. That last one causes real bugs.

topics.workingTitle: A realtime Svelte dashboard: live cell updates without re-rendering the grid
topics.brief: Patching rows from a websocket, cell flash on change, keeping sort and filter stable while data moves. Numbers for updates per second.

topics.workingTitle: An international phone input in Svelte that emits E.164
topics.brief: Country dial-code selection, national formatting while typing, and emitting a single E.164 string. Be clear that formatting is not validation.

topics.workingTitle: Svelte data grid i18n and RTL: locale text, number formats, mirrored layout
topics.brief: The localeText map, Intl-based formatting in cells, and switching the whole grid to RTL. Show an Arabic or Hebrew example with real screenshots described in text.

topics.workingTitle: A Svelte carousel with keyboard, swipe and reduced-motion support
topics.brief: Slide navigation, autoplay with pause-on-hover and prefers-reduced-motion, and the ARIA roles. Say when a plain scroll container beats a carousel.

topics.workingTitle: api.applyTransaction: adding, updating and removing rows without resetting the grid
topics.brief: The transaction object shape, what state survives (selection, scroll, sort), and when to prefer replacing the array. One worked example per operation.

topics.workingTitle: A product tour in Svelte: spotlight an element, step through, let people leave
topics.brief: Anchoring to a target, spotlight and scroll-into-view, step order, and remembering that the user already saw it. Skippable at every step.

topics.workingTitle: api.setActiveCell: moving focus in a Svelte grid from your own code
topics.brief: Focus a cell after a search hit, after adding a row, after validation fails. Explain scrolling into view and what screen readers announce.

topics.workingTitle: A star rating in Svelte with half steps and a real keyboard story
topics.brief: Hover preview versus committed value, half-star steps, read-only display, and the ARIA slider pattern behind it.

secondary: svelte table fit columns to content
topics.workingTitle: api.autosizeColumn and fitColumns: sizing Svelte grid columns to content or to the viewport
topics.brief: The two sizing strategies, when each runs (data change, resize), and the cost of measuring text. Include a responsive example.

topics.workingTitle: A Svelte date picker inside a form: SvCalendar, ranges and validation
topics.brief: Single date, range and min/max constraints bound to form state, then the same picker as a grid cell editor. Keyboard behaviour in one paragraph.

topics.workingTitle: A Svelte combobox with async search and keyboard selection
topics.brief: Debounced remote search, loading state, creating a new option, and using it as a cell editor. Show the ARIA combobox pattern the component implements.

topics.workingTitle: A Svelte progress bar: determinate, indeterminate, buffered, and in steps
topics.brief: Upload progress, a multi-step wizard, and a ring for a dashboard tile. Cover reduced motion and the ARIA progressbar attributes.

topics.workingTitle: A Svelte accordion for an FAQ section: single or multiple open, keyboard first
topics.brief: An FAQ built with SvAccordion, deep-linking to an open item, and the disclosure ARIA pattern. Keep it short; it is a small component.

topics.workingTitle: A Svelte tree view with checkboxes, search and lazy-loaded nodes
topics.brief: Folder-style data, tri-state checkboxes, filtering the tree, loading children on expand, and virtualizing thousands of nodes.

topics.workingTitle: A Svelte command palette (Cmd+K) with groups, shortcuts and async results
topics.brief: Registering commands, fuzzy matching, recent items, and opening it from a global shortcut. Mention using it to jump between grid rows.

topics.workingTitle: A Svelte dock layout: draggable, resizable dashboard panels that remember their place
topics.brief: Panels, tabs, splitting, persisting the layout to localStorage, and putting a grid inside a panel. Describe the layout model as data.

topics.workingTitle: A Svelte rich text editor: toolbar, HTML output and use as a grid cell editor
topics.brief: Bound HTML value, the toolbar configuration, sanitising output, and editing a notes column in a grid. Be honest about what it does not do (no collaborative editing).

topics.workingTitle: A Svelte password input with a strength meter and show/hide toggle
topics.brief: Reveal toggle, strength rules, confirm-password validation, and wiring into SvForm. Short post.

topics.workingTitle: A Svelte button component: variants, sizes, icons and a loading state
topics.brief: The variant and size matrix, icon-only buttons with labels for screen readers, a loading state that keeps width, and theming with tokens. Short post.

topics.workingTitle: A Svelte scheduler component: day, week and resource timeline views from grid rows
topics.brief: Events as rows, the scheduler prop, switching views, dragging to reschedule, and resources as lanes. State that the renderer is in the enterprise package.

topics.workingTitle: A Svelte Gantt chart with the scheduler timeline: tasks, dependencies, progress
topics.brief: What the timeline view gives you for a Gantt (bars, dependencies, drag to move) and what a dedicated Gantt library would add that SvGrid does not. Honest scope.

topics.workingTitle: A Svelte date-time picker: time zones, steps and parsing typed input
topics.brief: Combined date and time, minute steps, typed input that parses, and binding to an ISO string. Cover the 12/24 hour switch.

topics.workingTitle: Looking at SVAR Svelte DataGrid? What changes if you pick SvGrid instead
topics.brief: A fair, feature-by-feature comparison for someone already evaluating SVAR: licensing, Svelte 5 runes, virtualization, editing, enterprise views, and the migration path. Credit what SVAR does well.

topics.workingTitle: AG Grid with Svelte 5: what works, what breaks, and the native option
topics.brief: How people actually run AG Grid inside Svelte (vanilla API in onMount), the reactivity and SSR seams that show up, bundle size, and when the Svelte-native grid is the better fit. No bashing.

topics.workingTitle: Choosing a Svelte table component in 2026: the checklist that matters
topics.brief: Runes-native or wrapped, virtualization, editing depth, accessibility, license, AI grounding. A checklist with a one-line reason each, then how SvGrid scores on it honestly.

topics.workingTitle: A responsive Svelte table: card view on phones, grid on desktop
topics.brief: The responsive prop, the breakpoint where columns unpin, and the card renderer for narrow screens. Show the same data at three widths.
